title: EU Power of Attorney Attestation Credential
description: Example credential claim schema derived from docs/v1.0_eu_poa_attestation_descript.docx for use in iGrant EUDI issuance exercises.

date_of_execution.description: Date on which the power of attorney was executed. It should be equal to or earlier than validity_period_valid_from.

euid_reference.description: EUID reference for the company to which the power of attorney applies.

principal_full_name.description: Legal full name of the principal acting on behalf of the company.

principal_date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the principal.

principal_identification_document_kind.description: Type of identification document presented by the principal.

principal_identification_document_number.description: Document number of the principal's identification document.

principal_place_of_birth.description: Place of birth of the principal.

company_statutory_full_name.description: Registered legal name of the company.

company_business_register_name.description: Name of the business register in which the company is registered.

company_jurisdiction.description: Country of incorporation of the company, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

company_registered_office.description: Registered office address of the company.

attorney_full_name.description: Legal full name of the attorney or delegate.

attorney_date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the attorney when available.

attorney_identification_document_kind.description: Type of identification document presented by the attorney.

attorney_identification_document_number.description: Document number of the attorney's identification document.

attorney_place_of_birth.description: Place of birth of the attorney.

scope_of_representation_powers.description: Granted powers under the power of attorney. The documented standard values include company formation, statute changes, branch registration or closure, cross-border conversions, cross-border mergers, and cross-border divisions. When scope_of_representation_power_of_substitution is limited, this array should also include the relevant limitation details.
examples: Registration and closure of branches of the Company
All legal transactions regarding cross border mergers involving the Company

scope_of_representation_power_of_substit.description: Whether substitution is allowed for the granted powers.

validity_period_valid_from.description: Start date from which the power of attorney is valid.

validity_period_valid_until.description: End date until which the power of attorney is valid. It should be later than validity_period_valid_from.

applicable_law_jurisdiction.description: Member State law governing the power of attorney, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

signing_place.description: Place where the power of attorney was signed.

signing_date.description: Date on which the power of attorney was signed.

scope_of_representation_powers: Registration and closure of branches of the Company
All legal transactions regarding cross border mergers involving the Company
